content.text: Skip to main content Hofstra Buildings Collection Collection Owner: Hofstra University - Hofstra University Library Cover Image: Hofstra University, South Campus, aerial view - Image Source Collection Facts Extent: 137 Dates of Original: 1935-1993 Explore the Collection >>> Go Historical Context Hofstra University is a private, non-profit, nonsectarian institution of higher learning. Its main campus is located in the village of Hempstead, New York. It originated in 1935 as an extension of New York University (NYU) called "Nassau College – Hofstra Memorial of New York University at Hempstead, Long Island"; in 1939, the institution separated from NYU and gained independence as Hofstra College, and in 1963, Hofstra College gained university status. Scope of Collection The Hofstra Buildings Collection consists of historic photographs of buildings on campus and include aerial views.
